name: page-header
title: Page Header
description: The top of every KOC application screen — title, optional breadcrumb, actions and meta. The title is an h1 because the app shell contributes no heading, so without it a screen has no top-level landmark at all.
docs: Keep breadcrumbs shallow. Directorate and Group are identity, not navigation, and the unit is already in the sidebar switcher — a breadcrumb here should carry only the path within the app.
